Male/female internal reproductive organisation is not an appendage roster. The visible petasma mention is insufficient to contextualize internal genital anatomy.

Ganglia, visceral loop, statocyst, osphradium and eye/tentacle do not illustrate reproduction. The exact nervous-system subsection is not default-visible; the visible senses subsection is too narrow for the full plate.

The aboral surface plate depicts madreporite, anus, spines and papulae. The default-visible External subsection explicitly treats the aboral face and is the correct broad external-morphology context.

The representative plate depicts mantle, head/eye, funnel and arms/tentacles. No default-visible subsection teaches the whole external body plan; Circulatory efficiency is misleading and Locomotion would falsely narrow the plate to the funnel.
